rows.quote: The PRD names a goal but no figure.
rows.title: Goal has no number to measure
rows.feedback: The PRD names a goal but no figure that says it worked.

rows.quote: The PRD does not say what the build will not do.
rows.title: Out-of-scope list is missing
rows.feedback: The PRD does not say what the build will not do.

rows.title: Mockup shows one role only
rows.feedback: The mockup only shows the helpdesk agent's screen. The requester's view is missing.

rows.title: Flowchart skips the analyst approval step
rows.feedback: Alerts go from scoring to action with no analyst sign-off drawn.

rows.quote: No number that says the use case worked.
rows.title: Success measure missing from the scope
rows.feedback: The PRD lists features but no number that says the use case worked.

rows.quote: The reviewer works from a phone between meetings.
rows.title: Mockup is desktop only and has no owner view
rows.feedback: The reviewer works from a phone between meetings. Show a small-screen layout and the owner's own list.

rows.quote: The flowchart ends at the match step.
rows.title: Flowchart does not show who approves exceptions
rows.feedback: Invoices that do not match need an approver. The flowchart ends at the match step.

rows.quote: The flowchart goes from ranking straight to raising tickets.
rows.title: Flowchart skips the scan approval step
rows.feedback: The flowchart goes from ranking straight to raising tickets. The scope says the manager approves the scan first, so that step must be drawn.

rows.quote: No target for match rate or time saved.
rows.title: Success measure missing from the scope
rows.feedback: No target for match rate or time saved.

rows.quote: Asset owners need a view of their own items.
rows.title: Mockup has no owner view
rows.feedback: The mockup only shows the analyst's triage table. Asset owners need a view of their own items with accept and dispute.
